cross_cutting.note_on_fuse_vs_absence: Display fuse NV_FUSE_OPT_DISPLAY=0 (not masked) yet the block is absent (poison on all paths): capability/fuse value does NOT imply operational presence. GR TPC fuse matches live tpc_nr, but that is corroborated by direct register reads, not assumed from fuse alone.
cross_cutting.note_on_cmpunlocker: cmpunlocker compute-rate unlock is an RM->SEC2 RPC that executes a NVIDIA-signed booter inside halted SEC2 (RESET_PLM=0xff). The FECS selector is written by firmware running in SEC2, not by the host. This is runtime evidence for the unlock path only; it is NOT a source-mapped engine<->firmware-slot assignment and does not imply other engines are programmable.
